copy.intro: External playlists enter as sources. The archive stays clean: review a track before it becomes part of the record.
copy.privacy: This first version does not sign into QQ Music or NetEase. It stores only the link, track metadata and your review decisions in this browser.
copy.pasteGuide: Paste one track per line as Title — Artist — Album. Album is optional. Tabs and hyphens also work.
copy.empty: No tracks are waiting for review.
copy.adapterNote: A future approved platform adapter can replace manual capture without changing the canonical library or your notes.
